两边受热不一样，空气会怎样走？: What happens when the two sides are heated differently?
风就是空气的流动。太阳让不同地方受热不一样，空气的温度和分布随之改变，可能形成气: Wind is moving air. The Sun heats places differently, changing air temperature and distribution and potentially creating pressure differences. A pressure difference pushes air. In this local example, air near the ground flows toward the warmer side, rises there and returns higher up.
把滑块移到中间，再移向另一侧：先比较有没有持续的环流，再看近地面气流怎样换方向。: Move the slider to the middle, then to the other side. First compare whether the circulation persists, then watch the near-ground flow change direction.
水平气压梯度力指向同一高度上气压较低的一侧：aₚ = −∇ₕp / ρ。差异加热: The horizontal pressure-gradient acceleration points toward lower pressure at the same height: aₚ = −∇ₕp / ρ. Differential heating changes the thickness and mass distribution of air columns; adjustment can establish a local circulation. Temperature alone does not determine surface pressure. Real winds also depend on Earth’s rotation, friction and prior motion. This illustration includes only a local circulation maintained by differential heating. Equal heating does not mean that real-world winds must stop.
同一股风，遇见不同的地形: The same wind meets different terrain
空气遇到山坡和房屋，会穿过去吗？: Does air pass straight through hills and houses?
空气会绕过障碍，也可能被地形抬升。靠近地面，树木、建筑和地面的摩擦还会改变风速。: Air flows around obstacles and can be lifted by terrain. Near the ground, friction from trees, buildings and the surface also changes wind speed. Behind an obstacle, flow may become irregular and form local eddies.
在平地、山坡和房屋之间切换，沿着箭头看气流怎样改变路径。这里画的是侧面的绕行路线: Switch between open ground, a hill and a house. Follow the arrows to see the path change. This side view shows a route around each obstacle.
固体边界限制气流穿透，地形、表面摩擦和来流条件共同改变流场。背风侧可发生分离与湍: Solid boundaries limit flow through them. Terrain, surface friction and the incoming flow shape the resulting wind field. Separation and turbulence can occur on the lee side; hills do not all create the same eddies. These smooth, prescribed paths do not calculate building wind loads, simulate turbulence or predict local wind speed.
白天吹向陆地，夜里可能反过来: Toward land by day; sometimes back toward the sea at night
同一个海岸，换到夜里会发生什么？: What changes at the same coast after nightfall?
晴朗、背景风较弱时，白天陆地常比海面升温快，近地面的海风吹向陆地。夜间陆地也常冷: In clear weather with weak background winds, land often warms faster than the sea by day, and a near-surface sea breeze blows inland. Land often cools faster at night, allowing a land breeze to blow toward the sea. Look higher up for the returning air.
切换白天和夜晚，先找出较暖的一边，再比较海面附近与高处的气流方向。: Switch between day and night. Find the warmer side first, then compare the near-surface and upper-level flow directions.
海陆风是热力驱动的局地环流。陆地与水体的有效热容量、混合和蒸发不同，使日变化产生: Sea and land breezes are thermally driven local circulations. Differences in effective heat capacity, mixing and evaporation produce a daily temperature contrast; the pressure field changes as the air columns adjust. Background winds, clouds, terrain and sea temperature can weaken, strengthen or prevent this circulation. The arrows show idealized established circulations, not an instantaneous reversal of all winds at sunset.
看不见的空气，也能推动世界: Invisible air can move the world
同样的风，种子、沙粒和帆会有同样的反应吗？: Do seeds, sand grains and sails respond to the same wind in the same way?
风能带着一些种子旅行、搬运沙粒、推动帆，也能带动风轮。物体的形状、质量和是否被固: Wind carries some seeds, transports sand, pushes sails and turns wind wheels. Shape, mass and whether an object is anchored affect its response. Winds also transport moisture and stir the sea; strong winds can break branches and damage buildings.
慢慢调大风，比较种子、沙粒、帆和风轮的变化。再把风调回零：没有持续风力时，演示中: Slowly increase the wind and compare the seed, sand, sail and wheel. Return it to zero: without sustained wind forcing, the illustrated motion stops.
空气通过压力和摩擦向物体传递动量。在其他条件固定的近似下，阻力 F ≈ ½ρCᴅ: Air transfers momentum through pressure and friction. With other conditions approximately fixed, drag F ≈ ½ρCᴅAv². Actual responses also depend on shape, exposed area, anchoring and material. Sand has an entrainment threshold; seeds respond to both gravity and drag. These dimensionless responses do not convert the slider into wind categories, electricity output or safety thresholds.
画面暂时无法显示，仍可阅读讲解。: The scene is unavailable. You can still read the explanation.
海陆受热相近: Similar heating over sea and land
本例环流静止: Circulation is still in this example
开阔地面上，先沿着空气走一圈。靠近海面的一段与高处的一段，方向相反。: Over open ground, follow the air around one full circuit. The near-surface and upper branches move in opposite directions.
同一片海岸：受热改变环流，环流经过地形，也推动身边的物体。: One coast: heating changes circulation, which meets the terrain and moves objects around it.
局地环流 · 海与陆的侧向对比: Local circulation · sea and land side by side
海在左，陆在右 · 可以拖动换角度 · 示踪线不是云或尘粒: Sea on the left, land on the right · drag to orbit · tracers are not clouds or dust
本例只展示受热差异驱动的环流；真实海岸还有背景风、天气与地形影响。: This example shows circulation driven by unequal heating. Real coasts also experience background winds, weather and terrain effects.
从受热差异，追到空气运动: From unequal heating to moving air
走完整个环流，再看地形的影响: Follow the circuit, then look at terrain
不要离开这片海岸：树冠和草向风的一侧弯，帆受到力，风轮转动，种子随空气移动。把受: Stay on this coast: crowns and grasses bend downwind, the sail feels a force, the wheel turns and seeds travel with the air. Reduce the heating contrast and compare how these responses weaken together. Switch to night to see the near-surface wind reverse.
先比较白天与夜晚，再把受热对比移到中间。看近地风，也看高处的返回气流。: Compare day and night, then move the heating contrast to the middle. Watch both the near-surface wind and the return flow above.
在山坡、房屋和开阔地面之间切换，再转到侧视。气流会绕过地形，不会穿过实体。: Switch between a hill, a house and open ground, then use the side view. Air flows around terrain rather than through solid objects.
关闭气流示踪，只凭树、帆、风轮和种子，还能看出空气在动吗？: Hide the air tracers. Can you still tell the air is moving from the trees, sail, wheel and seeds?
地形、环流和物体响应为定性示意，尺度与速度未经校准；不计算真实风荷载或发电量。: Terrain, circulation and object responses are qualitative illustrations. Scales and speeds are not calibrated; the scene does not calculate actual wind loads or power output.
把视野拉到整个热带气旋：近海面汇入、旋转、上升与高空外流同时存在。: Widen the view to a whole tropical cyclone: near-surface inflow, rotation, rising air and upper outflow coexist.
拖动三维云系，比较风眼、眼墙与雨带 · 暖色示意上升，青绿示意低层汇入: Orbit the clouds to compare eye, eyewall and rainbands · warm tracers rise; teal tracers flow inward below
风的影响，不止最大风速: Wind matters beyond its peak speed
台风能把热量和水汽带到很大的范围。强风推动海水、卷起浪，也可能损坏建筑；暴雨和风: Typhoons transport heat and moisture across large areas. Strong winds push seawater, raise waves and can damage buildings; heavy rain and storm surge also bring flood risks. A temporary lull in the eye does not mean the storm is over.
保持海面温暖，增大高低空风差，观察云系组织受什么限制；也可以从头看形成。: Keep the sea warm and increase the difference between winds aloft and below. Watch what limits cloud organization, or replay formation from the beginning.
比较眼区、眼墙与外围雨带，再选择眼墙置换：受影响的范围与最大风速不是同一件事。: Compare the eye, eyewall and outer rainbands, then select eyewall replacement. The affected area and the peak wind speed are different properties.
来到雷暴下方：比较高低空的风与上升气流，追踪局部旋转怎样发展。: Move beneath a thunderstorm. Compare winds at different heights and the updraft to follow the development of local rotation.
雷暴局部 · 与台风不按同一比例显示: Local thunderstorm view · not to the same scale as the typhoon
侧面观察雷暴 · 凝结云可隐藏，空气旋转仍需单独观察: Side view of a thunderstorm · hide condensation clouds to examine air rotation separately
看得见的漏斗，不是全部空气: The visible funnel is only part of the air
小范围，也可能有很强的作用: Powerful effects in a small area
可见漏斗由凝结的小水滴组成；它的末端不一定显示空气旋转达到的最低位置。关闭凝结云: The visible funnel consists of condensed droplets. Its tip need not show the lowest extent of rotating air. Hide condensation clouds and follow the tracers. Rotation inside a thunderstorm is not yet a ground-contacting tornado.
龙卷风的强风和飞散物会在局部造成严重破坏。它的危险不能只凭漏斗是否粗大或清楚判断: A tornado’s winds and flying debris can cause severe local damage. Funnel size and visibility alone do not tell you how dangerous it is. Follow adults and local warning guidance to shelter; do not approach to watch.
隐藏漏斗云，然后降低上升气流：区分云的可见性与近地旋转是否发展。: Hide the funnel cloud, then weaken the updraft. Distinguish cloud visibility from the development of rotation near the ground.
与台风对照：比较形成条件和空间范围，不要根据两幅画面在屏幕上的大小判断真实尺度。: Compare formation conditions and spatial extent with the typhoon. Their on-screen sizes do not indicate their real sizes.
在同一个观察台里，追踪海岸、台风和龙卷风中的空气，比较形成条件、流动与影响。: Follow air on a coast, in a typhoon and in a tornado within one observatory. Compare formation conditions, flow and effects.
看不见的空气，怎样推动看得见的世界？: How does invisible air move the world we can see?
从一片海岸出发，追踪空气，再换个尺度观察风暴。: Start on a coast, follow the air, then change scale to explore storms.
同一片海岸：追踪近地风，再看树、帆和风轮怎样回应。: On the same coast, follow near-surface air and watch the trees, sail and wheel respond.
把云隐藏后，旋转的空气还在吗？: Does rotating air remain when the cloud is hidden?
同样是空气流动，条件与尺度却不同: Moving air, different conditions and scales
海陆风、台风、龙卷风并不是三个强弱等级。改变观察环境，是在比较不同的形成条件。: Coastal breezes, typhoons and tornadoes are not three wind-strength levels. Changing environments lets you compare different formation conditions.
受热差异形成局地环流，地形和地面物体改变它的路径。: Unequal heating creates local circulation; terrain and surface objects change its path.
海气能量交换与大范围旋转相互配合；强风、暴雨和风暴潮共同影响环境。: Ocean–atmosphere energy exchange interacts with large-scale rotation. Winds, rain and storm surge affect the environment together.
部分雷暴中形成近地面强涡旋，不能把它当成缩小的台风。: Some thunderstorms develop an intense vortex near the ground. It is not a miniature typhoon.
互动需要启用 JavaScript。风是流动的空气；台风和龙卷风有不同的形成条件: Enable JavaScript for interactions. Wind is moving air; typhoons and tornadoes have different formation conditions and scales.
眼：中心的下沉空气增温、变干，云较难维持；近海面风通常比眼墙弱。眼区仍可能有低云: Eye: descending air warms and dries, making deep clouds harder to sustain. Near-surface winds are usually weaker than in the eyewall. Low cloud can remain; the eye is not a vacuum.
眼墙：围绕眼的深厚雷暴，空气强烈上升、凝结放热，常有最强风雨。斜视或剖面可以看到: Eyewall: deep thunderstorms surround the eye. Strong ascent and condensation release heat, with often the strongest winds and rain. An oblique or cutaway view reveals its height.
外围雨带：不均匀的螺旋状对流与降雨区，云间留有空隙；高空外流与近海面向内汇流方向: Outer rainbands: uneven spirals of convection and rain, separated by gaps. Upper-level outflow differs from the inward flow near the sea.
先找到空气来去的路: First, find where the air comes from and goes
从海岸开始：低处的空气流过来，在较暖的一侧上升，高处又返回。把地面和天空一起看，: Start at the coast: air arrives below, rises on the warmer side and returns above. Look at the ground and sky together to see this circulation.
记住这三个问题：空气从哪里来？在哪里上升？到了高处又去哪里？: Remember three questions: Where does air come from? Where does it rise? Where does it go aloft?
白天的海风从海面吹向陆地。换到夜晚，陆地可能更冷，近地风会反向。: A daytime sea breeze blows from sea to land. At night, land may become cooler and the near-surface wind can reverse.
较暖一侧的空气上升；不是只有你身边那一层空气在运动。: Air rises on the warmer side. Movement is not limited to the air around you near the ground.
高处有返回的气流，另一侧有下沉。这是海陆风的理想化环流，不是每一阵风都必须绕成的: Air returns above and sinks on the other side. This is an idealized coastal circulation, not a loop that every wind must follow.
带着三个问题，走进台风: Take those three questions into a tropical cyclone
还记得“低处来、往上走、高处去”吗？在台风里也能找到这条线索；这次低层空气一边向: Remember air arriving below, rising and leaving above? Find the same clues in a tropical cyclone. This time the lower air flows inward while rotating around the center.
新条件：暖海供给热量和水汽，凝结释放热量，地球自转影响大范围气流转向。海岸环流不: New conditions: warm seas supply heat and moisture, condensation releases heat, and Earth’s rotation influences large-scale turning. Coastal circulation does not directly transform into a tropical cyclone.
近海面的空气从外围螺旋向内走。只俯视云图，容易漏掉它向内和向上的运动。: Near the sea, air spirals inward from the surroundings. A top view of clouds can hide the inward and upward components.
很多暖湿空气在眼墙中上升；风眼中心则可有下沉。环流里不同位置的运动不同。: Much of the warm, moist air rises in the eyewall; sinking occurs in the eye. Different parts of the circulation move differently.
空气在高处向外流出。周围环境还会与风暴交换空气，不是同一团空气在一个封闭小圈里无: Air flows outward aloft. The storm also exchanges air with its surroundings; the same parcel does not travel endlessly around one small closed loop.
再问一次：雷暴里的空气怎样走？: Ask again: how does air move in a thunderstorm?
同样先找进入和上升的空气，再看旋转集中在哪里。龙卷风是雷暴中的局部强涡旋；它不是: Again, find incoming and rising air, then look for concentrated rotation. A tornado is an intense local vortex associated with a thunderstorm, not a miniature tropical cyclone.
新条件：不同高度的风和雷暴上升气流参与旋转的发展。并非每个旋转的雷暴都会产生触地: New conditions: winds at different heights and the thunderstorm updraft help rotation develop. Not every rotating thunderstorm produces a tornado touching the ground.
这里观察已形成的近地面涡旋：空气可以向内汇入。形成过程另需观察风切变、上升气流与: This diagram examines an established near-ground vortex with inward airflow. Formation also requires examining wind shear, updrafts and near-ground conditions.
一条上升路线加上旋转，看起来像绕着轴走的螺旋；真实龙卷风内部还可能有下沉和多个小: Rising motion combined with rotation traces a spiral around an axis. Real tornadoes can also contain sinking air and multiple smaller vortices.
龙卷风与上方雷暴相连，雷暴还包含其他上升和下沉气流。侧面的简图没有画出全部三维运: A tornado connects to the thunderstorm above, which has other rising and sinking currents. This side diagram does not show all three-dimensional motion.

操场长 100 米、假想城区宽 20 千米，都是本图的参照物。数字比较的是沿直径: A 100 m playground and an imaginary city area 20 km wide are reference objects. The comparison places their lengths end to end along a diameter; it does not compare areas.
台风和飓风是同类热带气旋在不同海域的称呼。这里的 500 与 1000 千米是云: Typhoons and hurricanes are regional names for the same type of tropical cyclone. The 500 and 1000 km cloud spans here are teaching examples, not fixed sizes for every storm or record maxima.
